summary.zh-CN: 提供 v2 包脚手架生成、结构合规校验、冻结评测、对比风险评估与 CAS 激活/回滚的官方动态扩展。
summary.en-US: Official dynamic extension for v2 package scaffolding, conformance validation, frozen evaluation, comparison risk policy, and CAS promotion/rollback.

description.zh-CN: OPL Foundry 将包脚手架、opl.package.v2 结构校验、非弱化评测策略对比、哈希链运行账本及 Owner 门禁激活整合为独立零依赖动态扩展，通过 provides.cli_extensions 注册 opl foundry 命令面。
description.en-US: OPL Foundry provides zero-dependency dynamic CLI capabilities (init, validate, eval, compare, promote, rollback) via provides.cli_extensions without coupling extension logic into OPL core.

default_prompts: Use OPL Foundry to scaffold and validate a new opl.package.v2 agent package.
Use OPL Foundry to evaluate and compare candidate agent revisions under non-weakening gates.

reason.zh-CN: 用于初始化新包脚手架、读取目标包目录执行静态合规校验与只读评测
reason.en-US: Scaffold new package directories and inspect target packages for conformance validation and evaluation
